title: SoundPack
description: The MENU of sounds: files plus the cue/bed vocabulary a theme selects from. The fourth data layer (D48) and the only one besides component packs that carries bytes. Files live next to the manifest under contracts/sound-packs/<name>/. The AI never sees this.

license.description: The library's vocabulary (D72, supersedes D33), pack-wide. A pack mixing licenses should be split in two. `restricted` is absent for the same reason it is absent from a channel's allow-list: a pack we may not use is a pack we do not ship.

attribution.description: credit line required by the license, if any; carried into asset provenance

cues.description: one-shots and loops a theme can bind to an overlay entrance or a transition

beds.description: background music, selected by mood span

file.description: relative to the pack folder, e.g. sfx/swoosh-soft.mp3

kind.description: one_shot plays once at its own length; loop is trimmed to the window the compiler gives it (a typing bed under a typewriter entrance)

duration_s.description: real file duration; the compiler sizes one_shot items from it

lead_s.description: start this many seconds BEFORE the visual it belongs to — a swoosh whose transient should land on the entrance, not begin there

gain.description: per-cue trim; multiplied by the theme's sfx gain

priority.description: when the min-gap rule drops one of two colliding cues, the higher priority survives

fade_out_s.description: loop cues need one; one-shots rarely do

file.description: relative to the pack folder, e.g. beds/tense-01.mp3

mood.description: the mood this bed answers; the theme's mood_beds map may still override

loopable.description: false means the bed must not be extended past its own length

gain.description: per-bed trim; multiplied by the ducking envelope

mood.description: the beat sheet mood vocabulary; kept identical in beat_sheet.schema.json
